card.name: The word "the" before class or recommended
card.fires_on: Mostly the word "the" (sometimes "maximum") right after "in", "than" or "times", just before "class" or "recommended dose" in warning text.

modes.label: Class wording
modes.description: "the" after "in" in statements about other drugs in the same class.
modes.example: antipsychotic agents, including asenapine. Agranulocytosis (including fatal cases) has been reported with other agents in<< the>> class. Possible risk factors for leukopen

modes.label: Above recommended amount
modes.description: "the" or "maximum" after "longer than", "higher than" or "times", before "recommended" dose or duration.
modes.example: Reversible Encephalopathy Syndrome (PRES). PRES has been observed in patients treated with niraparib as a single agent at higher than<< the>> recommended dose of niraparib included
